reviews.title: Unintuitive as a guitar tuner
reviews.text: I’ve used more intuitive guitar tuning apps, but those demand a subscription fee. Since the reviews were stellar, I naturally thought this app would provide what those apps do, but it doesn’t. It might be a useful guitar tuning app for intermediate players, but for beginners and people learning guitar intuitively, it’s unnecessarily complex and lacks the intuitive approach of the subscription-based tuning apps.
